`5105-28240-0004.wav` and `.txt` are one utterance from the LibriSpeech ASR
corpus (test-clean), as converted to 16-bit WAV by
[phonon-2-c](https://github.com/eschmidbauer/phonon-2-c)'s test data.
LibriSpeech is by Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey and Sanjeev
Khudanpur, derived from LibriVox public-domain audiobooks, and is licensed
CC BY 4.0 (https://www.openslr.org/12).

Used by the opt-in transcription test in `src/stt.rs`.
